compute_baseline_loss: compute the baseline loss from advantage values using mean squared advantages across timesteps
compute_entropy_loss: compute the entropy loss from policy logits to encourage exploration via softmax entropy
compute_policy_gradient_loss: compute the policy gradient loss from logits, actions, and advantages using weighted cross entropy
compute_forward_dynamics_loss: compute the forward dynamics loss by measuring L2 norm between predicted and actual next embeddings
compute_inverse_dynamics_loss: compute the inverse dynamics loss by classifying predicted actions against true actions using cross entropy
